title: SosRelay: monotonic origin-sequence validator
description: Gap 5 of a6qg: no monotonic origin-sequence validator anywhere; SosRelay (python/src/lichen/coap/sos_relay.py) dedups exact (node,seq) only, so stale-but-unseen origin sequences are relayed; vector origin_sequence_rollback expects reject (spec 18.4.1: sequence must be monotonically increasing per origin). Track last-seen seq per node; reject seq <= last_seen. Update green doc test test_origin_sequence_rollback_live_behavior to assert rejection per vector.
